questions.question: Dairy comes under which sector of economic activity?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Primary sector.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points:__**

 
• Activities that generate income are termed as economic activities.
 
• On the basis of economic activities, the Indian economy can be divided into 3 major sectors that are the **primary sector**, the secondary sector, and the tertiary sector.
 
• Dairy comes under the primary sector.
 
• Primary sector: Primary activities are directly dependent on the environment as these refer to the utilization of the earth’s resources. It, thus includes hunting and gathering, pastoral activities, fishing, apiculture, etc.
 
• Secondary sector: Secondary activities add value to natural resources by transforming raw materials into valuable products. Therefore, they are concerned with manufacturing, processing and construction industries. For eg: Shoe factory.
 
• Tertiary sector: Tertiary activities include both production and exchange. The production involves the ‘provision’ of services that are consumed. The exchange involves trade, transport and communication facilities that are used to overcome distance. For eg: Consultancy.

questions.question: Which part of the plant conducts water?
questions.solution:
__
 
• The **stem**__ conducts __**water, minerals, and food **__to different parts of the plant. Stem consists of two types of vascular tissues, known as Xylem and Phloem.
 
• Xylem conducts water and minerals, while Phloem conducts synthesized foods to different parts of the plant.

questions.question: Which type of plants has weak stems and take support on neighbouring structures to climb up?
questions.solution:
__
 
• Climbers are a group of plants or vines which need the support of some kind as they have weak stems and hence take the support of neighboring structures to climb up.
 
• Some examples of climbers are Money plant, Bougainvillea, Morning glory etc.

 

**Explanation-**__

Plants can be categorized in many ways, including by their size, structure, and other characteristics. A common way is to differentiate them into groups such as trees, shrubs, climbers, and herbs. Here's a basic description of each:

 
• **Trees:** Trees are tall, woody plants usually with a single stem or trunk. They are generally distinguished by their size-typically they are over 10-15 feet tall. Some examples are oak, maple, and pine trees. Trees are an important part of our ecosystems as they provide habitats for a variety of organisms and play a significant role in producing oxygen through photosynthesis.
 
• **Shrubs**: Shrubs, also known as **bushes**, are medium-sized, woody plants. Unlike trees, shrubs typically have several stems and are shorter. They are usually less than 10 feet tall. Examples include holly, lavender, and rose bushes.
 
• **Climbers:** Climber plants, or vines, use support to grow upwards instead of growing erect independently like trees and shrubs. They may attach to structures, and other plants, or use aerial roots to climb. Some climbers like ivy can cover entire buildings or large trees, while others like sweet peas or grapevines are smaller.
 
• **Herbs:** Herbaceous plants or herbs are non-woody, flowering plants. They are generally short-lived and may complete their lifecycle within one or two seasons. They can be annuals (live for one season), biennials (live for two seasons), or perennials (return year after year). Examples include grasses, ferns, wildflowers, and crops such as wheat and rice. In another definition, "herbs" are also plants used in medicine or for seasoning food, such as basil, mint, or rosemary, but these can be trees or shrubs as well.

questions.question: If the momentum of a body is doubled, the kinetic energy is _____.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is__** becomes 4 times.**__

__
 
• The momentum of a body, P = mv, where m is the mass of the particle, and v is the velocity of the particle.
 
• The relation between Kinetic energy and momentum -

K.E = frac {p²}{2m}

frac {K.E₁}{K.E₂} =frac {frac {(p)²}{2m}}{frac {(2p)²}{2m}}

frac {K.E₁}{K.E₂} = frac {1}{4}

 
• Hence, If the momentum of a body is doubled, the kinetic energy becomes 4 times.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

The gravitational potential energy of a body at a point is defined as the amount of work done in bringing the body from infinity to that point against the gravitational force.

 
 The kinetic energy of a satellite in a circular orbit is half its gravitational energy and is positive instead of negative.
 
 
The sum of the kinetic and gravitational potential energy of a system is its total energy and this total energy is conserved in orbital motion.

questions.question: If action and reaction were to act on the same body, ________.

options.text: the body would not move at all

questions.solution:
• Action and reaction are two forces equal in magnitude that act in opposite directions to each other.
 
• Newton's third law explains the occurrence of action and reaction forces.
 
• If action and reaction were to act on the same body it would cancel out each other and the resultant would be zero.

questions.question: The soil is an example of which of the following?
questions.solution:
• The soil is an example of a heterogeneous mixture.
 
• It is a mixture of organic matter, minerals, gases, liquids, and organisms that together support life. The layer of soil on Earth's surface is called pedosphere.
 
• The soil texture is determined by the relative proportions of the individual particles of sand, silt, and clay that make up the soil.
